newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Malbak hits hitch in Haggie deal.
newsitem.headline: Malbak hits hitch in Haggie deal.

text.p: South Africa's Malbak Ltd said on Wednesday that its shareholders would not get any Haggie Ltd shares when it ubundles its listed holdings later this month.

The hitch is due to a hold up in a deal to sell 3.4 million Haggie shares to AMIC Industries Ltd (AIL) for 85 million rand. Malbak's remaining Haggie shares were due to be distributed to shareholders in the ratio of 1.247 Haggie shares for every 100 Malbak stocks.
The AIL deal has been held up due to certain unnamed conditions not yet being met and the transaction is now on hold.
"Because of this Malbak is currently unable to distribute to its shareholders those Haggie shares not sold to AIL," the firm said.

The hitch also means the cash from the deal will not received in time to be distributed to Malbak shareholders and they will now receive 75 rand for every 100 Malbak shares held, instead of the 100 rand announced in March.
A further announcement on the Haggie shares is to be made in due course, the firm added.
